name: her-world
description: Her World: a modular DSH-backed companion.

scripts.build: node scripts/build/clean-build.mjs && node scripts/build/build-desktop-animation.mjs && node scripts/build/build-animation-map.mjs && node scripts/build/build-pet-platform.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --test dist/tests/*/*.test.js tests/world/world-*.test.mjs

scripts.test:native-batch: pnpm run build && CHATPET_CHECK_BATCH=1 node scripts/checks/check-native-desktop.mjs
